description:
The Skoll Scholarship at Saïd Business School funds MBA candidates with a demonstrated commitment to social entrepreneurship — typically at least one full award each year covering fees plus living costs. Selection happens through the Oxford MBA admission rounds, so your MBA application is the scholarship application; the final stage closes in January 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Full MBA funding for social-impact entrepreneurs
  • No separate scholarship form — decided within MBA admission rounds
  • Saïd Business School's social-entrepreneurship ecosystem (Skoll Centre)
  • Final January deadline for the MBA round each cycle

Who Should Apply

MBA applicants with founder-level or leadership experience in social enterprises, impact ventures or mission-driven organisations.

Funding and Costs

Full course fees for the MBA plus a living-expenses grant for at least one Skoll Scholar each year.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply to the Oxford MBA in an early stage, complete the Skoll-related questions in the application, and target the January 2027 final round. Key deadline information: Considered automatically with the Oxford MBA application; final admission stage closes in January 2027.
